params.prompt:
Create an EPIC 8-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

JUNETEENTH CHAIR GUY — FOLD-OUT JUSTICE.
Preserve the exact joyful man, afro, green headband and sunglasses, open dark-green/yellow floral shirt, white tank top, olive shorts, layered jewelry, wrapped hands and green/white sneakers; one metal folding chair. Replace the reference's little chair crown graphic with a simple fist emblem and omit old chair lettering.
0–1.2s: establish full body; he checks the folded chair's hinge with a loud metallic snap, then winds his torso into an enormous athletic swing.
1.2–3.2s: he hurls the folded chair like a spinning boomerang far into the cyan distance. Camera follows its exaggerated corkscrew flight; sharp gold arcs and graphic metal afterimages show speed, with only ONE real chair.
3.2–4.8s: the chair curves back, growing huge in perspective as it breaks through a floating abstract red impact disk in a thunderous ink-and-gold burst. He catches it by the frame and swings it upward, stopping in a powerful protective stance. No human target or victim.
4.8–6s: snap push to his delighted grin as exact title "FOLD-OUT JUSTICE" slams into two readable comic lines, synchronized with the chair's final metallic clang.
6–8s: he smoothly unfolds that same chair, drops into the seat with his arms folded and nods as if the job is done. Camera eases wide enough to show the complete seated pose and chair. Sound: hinge snap, whistling metal spin, enormous comic impact, ringing catch, title slam, cheeky final seat creak.

HOMELESS WISEMAN — TOLD YOU..
Preserve the exact seated older dark-skinned man with long unkempt locs, expressive face, weathered olive patched jacket, layered necklaces, dark worn trousers and battered sneakers. Keep his crate seat and belongings as a finite cluster; no street scene. His personality is perceptive and unflappable.
0–1.2s: establish him seated on the crate. Eyes half-closed, he raises one finger BEFORE anything happens. Three small amber prediction arcs appear beside his hand.
1.2–3.2s: a gigantic fiery stone orb sweeps toward him through the cyan void. He calmly leans his head aside a split-second early. Camera whips around, revealing the enormous orb missed him and split into three massive orbiting pieces. Finite warm-colored stones and fire trails, no landscape or full background.
3.2–4.8s: without looking, he taps three fingers in a measured rhythm. The three pieces pass exactly where his fingers predicted, collide behind him ONE-TWO-THREE and explode into a spectacular gold clocklike ring of suspended fragments. He remains calmly seated in the center of the spectacle, no harm.
4.8–6s: camera snap-pushes to his knowing face as exact title "TOLD YOU." slams in; he gives the smallest eyebrow raise.
6–8s: camera eases back. He extends his empty palm before one last pebble arrives, catches it exactly on cue and tosses it aside with an unimpressed shrug. Sound: soft predictive ticks, huge incoming rush, three heavy collision beats, title impact, perfectly timed pebble click.

BONNET GIRL — NOW I'M UP.
Preserve the exact woman, shiny purple satin bonnet, long dark hair, purple patterned robe, lavender pajamas, oversized pink bunny slippers and white pillow.
0–0.7s: full-body view, she dozes into the pillow, then opens one eye with a fierce irritated glare and winds the pillow back.
0.7–2.4s: one outrageously fast spinning pillow swing unleashes a TOWERING cyclone of ink-edged white feathers and violet energy. Camera rockets back to reveal its enormous scale. She finishes with a decisive downward pillow strike against a suspended violet impact sigil, creating an enormous bunny-faced pillow-shaped shockwave, a huge comic impact burst and a brief hard hold. No floor plane, no person being struck, retain pure cyan around finite effect shapes.
2.4–3.5s: camera SNAP-PUSHES to her unimpressed face as exact title "NOW I'M UP" crashes in on two clear lines. One dominant spectacular impact, not a multi-step combo.
3.5–5s: she tucks the pillow under her cheek and gives a pointed glare; a final feather lands on a bunny slipper as camera eases to a readable hero view. Hold the title and personality pose through the last frame. Sound: fabric windup, accelerating feather whoosh, colossal soft bassy thump, title slam, soft settling tail. Five seconds total, confident pacing, no action beyond five seconds.

TATTOO ARTIST — PERMANENT INK.
Preserve the exact tattooed woman with dark-red loc updo, headband, black tank, ink-stained patchwork apron, red/black baggy trousers, black gloves, tool belt, chunky black/red shoes and tattoo machine. Keep existing tattoos stable.
0–0.7s: full-body stance; she buzzes the machine and draws one sweeping black-red stroke into empty air.
0.7–2.4s: that single stroke EXPLODES into an enormous coiling ink dragon with ivory highlights and crimson fins. Camera rapidly pulls back to show its huge finite silhouette spiraling around her. With her sharp finishing flick, the dragon folds into a monumental protective fist-and-shield emblem behind her: huge black/red/ivory splash, brief impact hold, clear cyan between graphic shapes. One coherent drawing-to-dragon-to-emblem transformation, no extra attacks.
2.4–3.5s: camera surges toward her confident expression as exact title "PERMANENT INK" slams into two readable comic lines.
3.5–5s: she twirls the tool into a steady ready pose and gives a satisfied grin at the enormous emblem, holding the title and final silhouette. No new permanent marks on her body. Sound: rising machine buzz, massive ink-whip rush, deep sealing impact, title stamp, final tool click. Five seconds total; strong final hold, not sped-up eight-second choreography.
